study.title: Data-efficient design of high-entropy oxygen carriers for chemical looping using active learning
study.citation: Brorsson et al., ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026); companion account Brorsson et al., Materials Today Energy 57, 102239 (2026).
study.workflow_type: Closed-loop active learning: WAE-GMM composition generation, Gaussian-process surrogate, Thompson sampling, CHGNet thermodynamic evaluation
study.assessment_scope: Completed by the authors from the run records of the oxygen-transfer-capacity campaign, as a counterpart to the publication record in brorsson-2026.json. The run records are not publicly deposited, so the values cannot be verified independently.

items.entry: Unchanged from the publication record. The published OTC values are about 5% too high owing to the molar-mass error described under evaluation; the order of the 20 reported candidates is unaffected.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: Given in stage_ledger below; counts refer to unique compositions for one acquisition strategy.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: As in the publication record. Duplicates are identified by exact matching of the chemical formula, or of the composition tag, for the fixed 80-atom cell. The labelled compositions are not publicly deposited.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: All models are retrained on the growing database in every cycle, and no predictive-generalisation claim is made.

As in the publication record, with an MMD weight of 0.1, a GMM with 5-10 components and full covariance, and a Matérn kernel with nu = 2.5. The exact random seeds were not recorded and cannot be recovered.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: WAE: Adam, learning rate 1e-3, batch size 64, 500 epochs; all models are reinitialised and trained from scratch in every cycle. Numerical precision, training hardware, and training time per cycle were not recorded.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: About 10,000 latent samples per cycle are decoded and rounded to integer occupations of the 16 A and 16 B sites, separately for each sublattice, by minimising the deviation from the continuous fractions under the constraint that the site counts sum correctly. A few thousand proposals per cycle pass the charge-neutrality, tolerance-factor, and entropy screens, and duplicates of labelled compositions are removed by exact formula matching. Inference throughput was not recorded.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: As in the publication record, with one correction: owing to an implementation error, in which the denominator took the molar mass of the last structure in the calculation loop, the OTC values were computed with the molar mass of the reduced phase (ABO2.5) rather than that of ABO3. With the latter, the values are about 5% lower and the highest OTC is 0.0539 rather than 0.0570 g(O2)/g(OC); the order of the 20 reported candidates is unchanged. Novelty: exact composition matching against all previously labelled entries. Individual deviations of the GP predictions from the CHGNet values are estimated at 0.005-0.01 g/g (an estimated range, not a measured mean absolute error). The best OTC of the individual parallel runs lies between about 0.050 and 0.057 g/g (values before the correction).
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: As in the publication record. Dynamical stability was not assessed: imaginary modes occur in several computed structures, mainly among the cubic configurations, but the phonon calculations served to estimate thermodynamic properties, and the 20 reported candidates were not examined for dynamical stability. The candidates are therefore thermodynamic nominations at the CHGNet evidence level. Synthesis was not performed.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: A matched random or enumerative search at the same number of CHGNet evaluations was not performed; the conclusion is bounded as in the publication record, namely that the loop improves OTC relative to the initial pool, not that it outperforms simpler search strategies.

Thompson sampling from the GP predictive distribution with n = 16 candidates per cycle; ten parallel runs of 10 cycles from the same initial pool with different seeds, merged and continued for 40 cycles (the five runs stated in the ACS Materials Au article refer to the verification campaigns); about 2,500 unique compositions, including the 1,066 of the initial pool, evaluated per acquisition strategy; a fixed number of cycles as stopping rule.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: The code and run records are not publicly deposited. Software: CHGNet 0.3.x with model checkpoint 0.3.0, phonopy 2.x, ASE 3.23 or an equivalent development version, GPyTorch 1.11-1.13, pymatgen 2024.x; exact versions, the environment, and a rebuild command were not recorded. Consequence: the entries of this record rest on run records held by the authors and cannot be verified independently.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: About three CPU hours per composition for the 19 SQSs and their phonon calculations, corresponding to about 7,500 CPU hours per acquisition strategy, or about three weeks with 16 concurrent processes, mainly on CPU nodes of the Tetralith and Vera clusters.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)

items.entry: Oxide oxygen carriers for energy applications; no hazardous target, autonomous execution pathway, or access restriction.

1,815 random compositions, of which 1,066 passed the chemistry screen and were labelled with CHGNet; ten parallel runs of 10 cycles, merged and continued for 40 cycles, with about 10,000 proposals and 16 evaluations per cycle; about 2,500 unique compositions evaluated per acquisition strategy, at about three CPU hours each; 20 candidates reported at the CHGNet evidence level, without an assessment of dynamical stability, with the highest OTC of 0.0539 g(O2)/g(OC) (0.0570 as published) for Ca13CoMgMn9Ti5Y3O48.
source_locations: Run records of the study, held by the authors (not publicly deposited)
